title: 35. Select the latest row per device

examples.explanation: The latest reading of device `a` has ts 9.
All three rows have ts 5. The greatest id, 3, wins.
The ts 20 row is after the cutoff, so the ts 5 row is the latest.

hints: Filter by cutoff inside the ranked subquery or common table expression.
Order each partition by ts DESC, id DESC, then keep row number one.
